name: Robust losses and trading frequency, 2022-2025
stop_rule: Run this finite batch once. Do not add candidates or alter settings after observing its test metrics. No guaranteed SPY outperformance.
early_stopping: Validation MSE for every model, including Huber; isolates change in training objective.
batch_rationale: Daily training includes every eligible daily origin. Fivefold batch size keeps approximately comparable updates per year; horizon comparison also changes batch size, so it is a pipeline comparison.
loss: Baseline objectives vs 2*Huber, delta=1 percentage point. Existing pairwise ranking penalty preserved where present.
architecture_ablations: THINK mixer residual scaled by 0.1; separate multi-scale MLP with 1/2/4-session average-pool patches, causal time mixing, 8-state market bottleneck, and MSE/Huber paired variants.
portfolio_details: 60-session signal-time inverse volatility, 10% annual volatility floor, 2/K position cap; target retention within top 2K. Buffer retains previous targets, including potentially unfilled names.
policy_selection: Prior-year validation only: median half-year/seed net Sharpe minus 0.25 std. Architecture selection aggregates available past/current validation scores, never future years.
evaluation: All seeds and policies retained. Fixed equal-K10 paired ablations; all policies compared to matched-date SPY; gross/net daily risk; annual and pooled evaluation; bootstrap and random controls. Pooled annual-fold series excludes boundary gaps and is not a continuous live account.
limitations: Fixed survivor cohorts with missing public histories; 2024-2025 previously examined. 2022-2023 extend regimes but were selected retrospectively and do not make this a pristine confirmation test. Paper-inspired architecture is not official replication. All comparisons exploratory; no success-only stopping.
